projects.practical_disposition: Phase 1 remains exactly APPROVED_SPACE_EXHAUSTED / RESEARCH_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED, and all Phase 2 evidence and terminal states remain unchanged. In Phase 3, mean-reversion v2 and relative-value rotation v2 each exhausted their newly authorized production-first completion rounds and remain IMPLEMENTATION_INCONCLUSIVE / NO_ECONOMIC_RESULT; neither was shown profitable or unprofitable, and no formal economic evaluation was completed. Route 4 remains deferred at DIRECTION_DESIGN_INCONCLUSIVE / NO_DATA_RESULT / NO_ECONOMIC_RESULT with no sixth review. The existing zero-capital prospective funding-availability collector is healthy under its frozen external contract: its latest closed report contained all 63,650 expected observations across ten registered streams, while its broader strategy data contract remains incomplete because realized settlements are not joined, Binance executable bid/ask is absent, and fees and slippage are not frozen. This is collection-health evidence, not a strategy result or profitability evidence. The first Phase 3 milestone, one clean development economic result, has not been reached. No candidate is promoted; all final holdouts remain unresolved, sealed, unopened, and unread; no order, exchange or wallet credential, capital, leverage, paid data, paid compute, model training, backtest, return calculation, GPU use, or mining change occurred at this checkpoint.
